# InputPageBlock

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.InputPageBlock`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(): ...
```

## Documentation

A block of a rich message to send.

It can be one of:

- [`InputPageBlockSectionHeading`](InputPageBlockSectionHeading.md)
- [`InputPageBlockParagraph`](InputPageBlockParagraph.md)
- [`InputPageBlockPreformatted`](InputPageBlockPreformatted.md)
- [`InputPageBlockFooter`](InputPageBlockFooter.md)
- [`InputPageBlockThinking`](InputPageBlockThinking.md)
- [`InputPageBlockDivider`](InputPageBlockDivider.md)
- [`InputPageBlockMathematicalExpression`](InputPageBlockMathematicalExpression.md)
- [`InputPageBlockAnchor`](InputPageBlockAnchor.md)
- [`InputPageBlockList`](InputPageBlockList.md)
- [`InputPageBlockBlockQuote`](InputPageBlockBlockQuote.md)
- [`InputPageBlockExpandableBlockQuote`](InputPageBlockExpandableBlockQuote.md)
- [`InputPageBlockPullQuote`](InputPageBlockPullQuote.md)
- [`InputPageBlockAnimation`](InputPageBlockAnimation.md)
- [`InputPageBlockAudio`](InputPageBlockAudio.md)
- [`InputPageBlockDocument`](InputPageBlockDocument.md)
- [`InputPageBlockPhoto`](InputPageBlockPhoto.md)
- [`InputPageBlockVideo`](InputPageBlockVideo.md)
- [`InputPageBlockVoiceNote`](InputPageBlockVoiceNote.md)
- [`InputPageBlockCollage`](InputPageBlockCollage.md)
- [`InputPageBlockSlideshow`](InputPageBlockSlideshow.md)
- [`InputPageBlockTable`](InputPageBlockTable.md)
- [`InputPageBlockDetails`](InputPageBlockDetails.md)
- [`InputPageBlockMap`](InputPageBlockMap.md)
- [`InputPageBlockButtonRow`](InputPageBlockButtonRow.md)

Wherever a rich text is expected, a `str` can be passed instead of [`RichTextPlain`](RichTextPlain.md).
Media can be passed as a file path, a file-like object, an HTTP URL or a file id, or as the matching
[`InputMedia`](../input_media/InputMedia.md) type to set its attributes (the caption of the input media is ignored).
